fix: Replace the call so overflow saturates instead of panicking: `Duration::try_from_secs_f32(seconds).unwrap_or(Duration::MAX)` (the surrounding guard already rules out negative and non-finite input). Keep the doc comment accurate: finite input too large for a Duration becomes Duration::MAX.

Add a private helper and use it for both fields: `fn scale_duration(duration: Duration, factor: f32) -> Duration { Duration::try_from_secs_f32(duration.as_secs_f32() * factor).unwrap_or(Duration::MAX) }`, then `duration: scale_duration(duration, factor),` (line 271) and `delay: scale_duration(self.delay, factor),` (line 278). `factor` is already finite and non-negative, so only overflow reached Duration::mul_f32 panics before; the helper saturates instead.
